verdict.rationale: Canny's own Autopilot feature is documented as automatically pulling feature requests out of call transcripts and capturing feedback from support, sales and review sources. That covers the automatic-detection half of the story. The docs never explicitly say Autopilot links detected feedback to related existing ideas, and the MCP theme analysis runs through an external LLM rather than Canny itself. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of AI linking or deduplicating extracted feedback into existing feature ideas, clear statement that Autopilot is AI-driven, and independent or hands-on corroboration of detection accuracy.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can rely on AI to automatically detect insights within feedback and link them to related feature ideas

citations.quote: Autopilot pulls feature requests out of your Fathom call transcripts automatically.
Autopilot captures feedback from support, sales, and review platforms automatically.
Send new conversations to Autopilot to capture feedback you haven't tracked yet.
